trap.see: The clock is locked, so both keys must go first; the tile lying on the clock is frozen and must be thawed first; one of the neighbours that can melt it is frozen itself (it needs its own neighbours); a key lies under a frozen tile, so thaw that tile first: do not melt with the free neighbour whose twin is buried: it would wait in the tray.
fairWhy: the loss shows only after 7+ more removals (> 6)
trap.uiNote: obKind() shows one overlay per tile (ice, else lock, else key): a tile that is both frozen and a key (or locked) would hide the key (or lock) badge, so it is never built; the chain freezes the key COVER, a way tile or a thaw-neighbour instead.

dennis.note: Awesome puzzle/trap. A bit too easy after that though but amazing trap!
